sql: SELECT "close" AS "close", "ts_code" AS "instrument", cast("trade_date" as long) AS "date" FROM "daily" WHERE "ts_code" = ? AND "trade_date" >= cast(? as TIMESTAMP) AND "trade_date" < cast(? as TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY "trade_date" ASC, "ts_code" ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT "close" AS "close", "ts_code" AS "instrument", cast("timestamp" as long) AS "date" FROM "etf_daily" WHERE "ts_code" = ? AND "timestamp" >= cast(? as TIMESTAMP_NS) AND "timestamp" < cast(? as TIMESTAMP_NS) ORDER BY "timestamp" ASC, "ts_code" ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "close" AS "close", "ts_code" AS "instrument", cast("trade_date" as long) AS "date" FROM "daily" WHERE "ts_code" = ? AND "trade_date" >= cast(? as TIMESTAMP) AND "trade_date" < cast(? as TIMESTAMP) AND (("trade_date" > cast(? as TIMESTAMP)) OR ("trade_date" = cast(? as TIMESTAMP) AND "ts_code" > ?)) ORDER BY "trade_date" ASC, "ts_code" ASC LIMIT 2
